summary: AI Assistant (gpt-5.4) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing including real LLM multi-turn context recall ('Dr. Elena' recalled in msg 2), auto-title, RBAC tabs (doctor=8 incl assistant, admin=14 incl assistant, biller has NO assistant), ownership 404 isolation, empty/oversized message 400 validation, create/list/delete conversations. Frontend: doctor sees nav-aiAssistant, assistant-page renders, sending real message returned assistant bubble within ~5s, convo appears in list, delete works, Enter sends & Shift+Enter inserts newline. Biller has no sidebar tab; visiting /assistant directly shows 'You don't have access to this section' gate.
critical_code_review_comments: assistant.py: DELETE always returns {ok:true} even if cid does not belong to user — could reveal nothing since row is silently ignored; acceptable but consider 404 for consistency with GET.
SYSTEM_PROMPT is rebuilt each call with last-20 messages embedded — for very long single messages this could exceed model context; consider truncating message content lengths, not just count.
MessageInput has no server-side pydantic max_length; validation is manual — fine but adding Field(max_length=8000) would return 422 automatically.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test ai_conversations for doctor user via the API (cleanup step in test_zzz_cleanup + delete_conversation test). No residual test data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note /api/auth/me returns tabs under key 'allowed_tabs' (not 'tabs'). LLM replies typically arrive in 3-8s. Assistant router is at /api/assistant/conversations. Multi-turn context works via embedding history into system prompt each call.
